source.description: A hunched undead mummy wrapped in tattered sand-stained linen bandages with a blue-and-gold pharaonic headcloth, clawed hands half-raised. Sways slowly, breathing, bandage strips swinging. Seamless loop.

The hunched mummy in tattered linen bandages with a blue-and-gold pharaonic headcloth attacks — rears back gathering itself, then lunges toward the camera slashing downward with both clawed bandaged hands, then recoils back into its hunched ready stance.

_notes: v3 humanoid character, south direction only. Base + animations approved before this session; this session only integrated frames/manifest/masks.
